subject: FacilityOperation operator cardinality
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Exactly one OperatingOrganizationRole and one OperatedFacilityRole per FacilityOperation; shared or successive operations use distinct relators with their own IDs and time/context
rationale: An operation assignment has one accountable organizational participant; independent relators preserve time and provenance and fit W6 single FK without ruling out joint activity across distinct assignments
evidence: ORSD FR-01/FR-03; W6 M011 schema; G3-P4a native/OWL/SHACL; issue #317 D03; #319 copied-W6 M2 run 40232374161: 4 SQL/SPARQL tuples, 5 SHACL negatives, OWL RL/HermiT
negative_boundary: Never infer a global unique operator for a facility; never merge two organizations into one; OWL missing values stay unknown
review_in_later_release: Reconsider true jointly held single-operation evidence and time/tuple policy before GA or next minor release

subject: Derived operates
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Define operates by the chain inverse(operationOrganization) then operationFacility; do not assert it from co-location or label
rationale: The relation has a FacilityOperation truthmaker and can be reproduced without duplicating asserted source facts
evidence: FR-01/FR-03 bounded tests #316; G3-P4a material relation annotation; #317 D04; #319 copied-W6 M2 run 40232374161: 4 SQL/SPARQL tuples, 5 SHACL negatives, OWL RL/HermiT
negative_boundary: No operation relator yields no derived triple; open-world absence is not falsity
review_in_later_release: Review source evidence and OWL DL profile/full validation before GA

subject: FacilityOperation source and evidence projection
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Use an optional versioned side-table for operation-to-existing EvidenceSupport identity; export a PROV source link only where a matching evidence row exists; preserve unknown provenance otherwise
rationale: W6 lacks an operation evidence FK; a reversible side-table preserves assertion/source/release/run lineage without inventing evidence or prematurely retyping M025 roles
evidence: #319 M2 copied-W6 run 40232374161; one clearly synthetic fixture link and three unknown operation sources; before/after row/schema/KG hashes equal
negative_boundary: A synthetic fixture source is not empirical facility-operation evidence; no automatic link from organization/facility co-location or label; do not promote EvidenceSupport role semantics
review_in_later_release: Obtain independently source-backed facility-operation records and adjudicate M025 typed EvidenceSupport and operation-level provenance before GA
